name: Camp Laurelwood
description_short: Jewish summer camp in Madison, CT. Overnight camp for grades 2-9 in sessions from 2 to 7 weeks, a day camp for rising K-7th graders that can be booked by the week, the Bonim travel program (grades 10-11) and an SIT program (grade 11). Overnight tuition is all-inclusive.

sources.note: '2027 Dates & Rates' hub; footer has address, phone and email; menu lists Overnight (2nd-9th), Day Camp (K-7th), Bonim (10th-11th), SIT (11th)
Overnight 2027 dates and regular rates; day camp sessions are on the day camp page listed in the note below
Day camp 2027: weekly rate $685 regular; 'Before and After Care may be added at any time.' Day camp session dates and prices in 'sessions' also come from this page
